trial_court: Principal Judge, Family Court, Hubli, M.C. No.180/2012
case_name: Shobha W/O Chidanand Bhagwat vs Chidanand S/O M Bhagwat
facts_of_case: Shobha filed a petition under Sec. 13(1)(ib) of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, which was allowed by the trial court. This appeal is against that judgment.

legal_principles.principle: A petition under Section 13(1)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, can be allowed if the respondent has wilfully neglected his duties as a husband.
legal_principles.held: The respondent has failed to discharge his marital obligations and has wilfully neglected his duties as a husband. It is held that the respondent's conduct is such that it justifies the grant of divorce.
use_in: divorce cases where respondent has neglected duties

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to prove that he has not wilfully neglected his duties as a husband.
legal_principles.held: The respondent has failed to discharge his marital obligations and has not been able to prove that he has not wilfully neglected his duties as a husband. The burden lies on him to prove that he has not committed any matrimonial misconduct.
use_in: divorce cases where respondent has neglected duties

outcome.final_order: The appeal is dismissed for non-prosecution.
